# Windows run of version 3 of the repository-build method, 28 October 2026, 07:12 to 09:45 CET, on GitHub-hosted
# windows-2022 standard runners of this repository (free on a public repository). Plan: dependencies/notes/2026-10-27-nupkg-repository-build-plan.md
# (section "Windows run of version 3"). Recipes: the version-3 derivation plus build_windows (derive-repo.py).
cd ~/Dev/Speciale2026/dependencies/experiments/nupkg
# derive the recipes (one per repository and commit; identical to version 3 apart from build_windows and node)
python3 -I derive-repo.py recipes/repository/batch-arcade.txt ../../data/2026-10-13-dependency-census/mac/census.files.csv ../../data/2026-10-27-nupkg-release-only-batch3-microsoft/derive /private/tmp/nupkg-repobuild recipes/repository/2026-10-28-nupkg-repository-build-windows --v3
# start the runner workflow: one job per standalone recipe (the 16 in the workflow's default list), all in parallel
gh workflow run nupkg-repository-build.yml -f runner=windows-2022                      # run 40642458858, 07:12 CET
# rerun of the four whose first job failed on a script fault (build.cmd adds -restore -build itself; commit 1bb44b0 -> fix)
gh workflow run nupkg-repository-build.yml -f runner=windows-2022 -f recipes='["msbuild-02bf662", "msbuild-995a3dc", "reverse-proxy-77f78d4", "symreader-27e5846"]'   # run 40642659531, 07:14 CET
# collect: download every artifact, classify with level.py on arch, write results.tsv and arch/<recipe>/ (later run wins per recipe)
python3 -I collect-runner.py 2026-10-28-nupkg-repository-build-windows 40642458858 40642659531
# the runtime 9.0.0 job of the first run hung after two hours (cancelled 09:15, its log is under arch/ in the lab download); the recipe rerun alone
gh workflow run nupkg-repository-build.yml -f runner=windows-2022 -f recipes='["runtime-9d5a6a9"]'   # run 40655532332, 09:16 CET
python3 -I collect-runner.py 2026-10-28-nupkg-repository-build-windows 40642458858 40642659531 40655532332
